input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable the quote agent
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off the agent is completely silent: it queues nothing and writes nothing.

input-field.name: llmApiKey
input-field.label: LLM API key
input-field.helpText: Your own key. Stored in system_config, obscured here but NOT encrypted at rest.

input-field.name: llmBaseUrl
input-field.label: LLM base URL
input-field.helpText: Point at Azure, your own gateway or a self-hosted model.

input-field.name: llmModel
input-field.label: Model name
input-field.helpText: The model to send each request to, e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Required: there is deliberately no default, because guessing one would pick a price and quality point for you.

input-field.name: negotiationStrategy
input-field.label: Negotiation strategy
input-field.helpText: Tone and commercial posture, e.g. "open at 2%, concede in 1% steps, never lead with the maximum". Appended to the negotiation prompt and used as the reply's tone instruction. It can never move a cap — the policies below are the guardrail.

input-field.name: maxDiscountPercent
input-field.label: Maximum discount (%)
input-field.helpText: 0 means every price ask escalates to a human.

input-field.name: counterOfferMaxPercent
input-field.label: Counter-offer ceiling (%)
input-field.helpText: An ask above the maximum but at or below this gets a deterministic counter at the maximum. Blank means no counter band.

input-field.name: maxQuoteValueNet
input-field.label: Maximum quote value for negotiation
input-field.helpText: Above this net total the quote always escalates. Only the net value is read; the gross box mirrors it because a system-config price carries no tax rate. Use "Maintain currency prices" to set a ceiling per currency — a quote in a currency you left blank escalates, because its ceiling is unknown rather than unlimited. Leave every currency blank for no ceiling at all.

input-field.name: a2cnOrganizationName
input-field.label: Organization name published in the A2CN seller mandate
input-field.helpText: Leave empty to publish the sales channel name. Advanced: only read when this shop publishes a signed A2CN seller mandate, so leave it alone otherwise.
